name: Default
shortDescription: OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with programmable pipelines, an OTLP endpoint and the Alloy debugging UI.

alerts.message: The default config.alloy only logs the telemetry it receives. Edit it to forward data to your backend (for example otelcol.exporter.otlphttp) and redeploy.
Alloy has no built-in authentication: anyone who knows the domain can open the UI and send OTLP data to https://<domain>/v1/. Restrict access in front of the app or add auth to the receiver.
